selection: Only original training IDs. Equal unchanged/increased/decreased counts; magnitude-spaced changing examples with deterministic hash ties.
training: Frozen MS06 settings except diagnostic epochs and gain. Fixed epoch budget; best checkpoint selected by diagnostic-subset training MAE, including epoch zero.
limitations: This outcome-stratified training subset tests learning mechanics, not generalization or deployment accuracy.
Training labels select examples and measure training loss; they never enter the encoder or graph store.
A lower training error does not authorize automatic promotion to a full-cohort model.
Gain 1 changes gradient and output scaling; it may also increase clipping or instability.
Gradient/decay norms are diagnostics, not a proof of why an optimizer succeeds or fails.
Graph swaps also change source availability; interventions can create unrealistic inputs.
Current text retains the retrospective limitations of MS06; no CVSS branch is added.
Verification reproduces saved predictions and checks recorded trace hashes; it does not replay every optimizer step.
